events.name: ELEW "The Top Professor" & Herlin Riley featuring Max Moran
events.info: ELEW "The Top Professor" & Herlin Riley featuring Max MoranExperience an electrifying night of jazz, rock, and improvisation featuring visionary pianist ELEW , "rdquo" -> The Top Professor"alongside legendary New Orleans drummer Herlin Riley, with bassist Max Moran. A classically trained jazz pianist, ELEW (Eric Lewis) first gained national recognition as the winner of the prestigious Thelonious Monk Competition and went on to perform alongside artists including Wynton Marsalis and Elvin Jones. He later re-emerged as ELEW, pioneering his signature , "rdquo" -> Rockjazz" sound---a dynamic fusion of jazz improvisation, classical technique, and modern rock and pop. ELEW's boundary-pushing performances have taken him around the world, from major brands and international events to the White House, where he performed for President Barack Obama. His creative work also extends into film composition, screenwriting, directing, and DJing. Joining ELEW is New Orleans jazz legend Herlin Riley, whose powerful drumming, deep musicality, and unmistakable Crescent City swing have made him one of the most respected figures in contemporary jazz. Bassist Max Moran rounds out this exceptional trio, bringing his distinctive sound and versatility to a musical encounter that promises spontaneity, groove, and virtuosic musicianship. Don't miss this rare meeting of three dynamic artists exploring the boundaries of jazz and contemporary music. events.name: Nickel-A-Dance: Jamil Sharif New Orleans Extravaganza
events.info: Nickel-A-Dance: Jamil Sharif New Orleans ExtravaganzaNickel-A-Dance is a free, family-friendly jazz concert series in New Orleans, celebrating the city's rich musical heritage. Founded in 1994, it features top local jazz musicians performing classic jazz, blues, and swing. Originally held at Café Brasil on Frenchmen Street, the series now takes place at Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro on Sundays from 3:00--6:00 PM. The event is open to all ages and aims to make live jazz accessible to everyone. Jamil Sharif is a celebrated New Orleans trumpeter, composer, and bandleader whose music reflects the rich traditions of his hometown. The son of renowned trumpeter Emery Humphrey Thompson (Umar Sharif), Jamil studied with New Orleans legends including Ellis Marsalis, Alvin Batiste, Roger Dickerson Sr., and Edward , "rdquo" -> Kidd" Jordan. His career includes performances with the Louisiana Philharmonic Orchestra, international festivals and concerts, Broadway productions, and contributions to the soundtracks of films including The Big Easy, Undercover Blues, and Ray. He has also released three critically acclaimed albums. For this special performance, Sharif leads The New Orleans Extravaganza in a spirited journey through traditional jazz, swing, classic R&B, and big band music. This is a free progam with no ticketing. Just come ready to dance. For more info on Nickel-A-Dance, visit: https://www.nojc.org/nickel-a-dance Shows from 3-6pm Doors at 2:30pm

events.name: Gasa Gasa Presents Bayonne - The ‘Filters’ Tour
events.info: NEW ORLEANS, were excited to bring Bayonnes Filters tour to Gasa Gasa on 10/18. These guys crushed opening for Minus the Bear last fall and we cant wait to see them again. See you there 💎 Theyll be joined by Bad Snacks as direct support! Bayonne Filters Bayonnes music captures the indescribable. For 10 years, the Austin, Texas-based experimental avant-pop/electronic musician, born Roger Sellers, has been creating atmospheric soundscapes brimming with layers, texture, and deep emotional resonance. On his fourth and most immersive album to date, Filters, Sellers picks up where he left us on 2023s mournful yet pop-minded Temporary Time. With its elegantly constructed melodies, silken synth-work, a sprinkle of field recordings, and an upbeat yet blissful blend of piano and percussion, Filters finds Sellers entering a new phase of existence as he works through the grief around losing his father and into a place of acceptance. Instagram | YouTube

events.name: Charmaine Neville Band
events.info: Charmaine Neville BandCharmaine Neville, daughter of legendary saxophonist Charles Neville of the Neville Brothers, carries the torch of a rich New Orleans musical legacy. While she is rooted in the city's vibrant traditions, Charmaine brings her own unique voice to the stage, blending R&B, Jazz, and world rhythms into a sound that's all her own. Her performances are a reflection of the city's spirit---bold, diverse, and deeply soulful. Renowned for her high-energy live shows, Charmaine and her band captivate audiences with an infectious sense of joy and a strong emphasis on audience participation. Whether delivering soulful ballads or rhythm-driven grooves, she creates an unforgettable experience, inviting listeners to feel the music and become part of the celebration. Charmaine Neville's sound is a true reflection of the Crescent City: timeless, exciting, and impossible to resist. events.name: A Benefit Concert for Wendell Brunious
events.info: A Benefit Concert for Wendell BruniousA Benefit Concert for Wendell Brunious Join us for a special evening of music and community in support of celebrated New Orleans trumpeter, composer, and educator Wendell Brunious. A vital ambassador of New Orleans,, Wendell Brunious has spent a lifetime carrying forward the musical traditions of Jazz. The son of legendary trumpeter John Brunious, Wendell continues a remarkable family legacy with a style defined by lyrical phrasing, a warm tone, and a deep connection to the heritage of our city. Over the course of his distinguished career, Wendell has performed and recorded with some of the most esteemed musicians including Wynton Marsalis, Lionel Hampton, Danny Barker, and Dr. John. He has also been a longtime member and Director of the Preservation Hall Jazz Band, helping bring the distinctive sound and spirit of New Orleans Jazz to audiences around the world. Now, the New Orleans music community is coming together to give back to a musician who has given so much to this city and its musical legacy. This special benefit concert will bring together an incredible lineup of musicians, friends, family, and supporters to celebrate Wendell's talents, artistry and enduring impact while raising funds to support him during his current battle with cancer. Come out, hear great New Orleans music, and show Wendell Brunious how much he means to us! Your ticket helps provide support for Wendell and his family during this challenging time. If you are unable to attend, donations are also encouraged and can be contributed here: https://tinyurl.com/4f7s7k9a One night. One community. One legendary New Orleanian and incredible musician. Come celebrate Wendell Brunious and help us surround him with love and support. This performance features: Mark Braud, Bruce Brackman, Roderick Paulin, Freddie Lonzo, Meghan Swartz, and Aron Lambert with Special Guests: Tom Hook snd John Boutté Show from 7:30pm - 9:30pm Doors at 7pm

events.name: FELICITY
events.info: Orlandos FELICITY are redefining what pop punk and emo can sound like in 2026: stadium sized hooks built for chaos, catharsis, and community. Breakout singles The Weather and GOD MODE have pushed the band into a new lane.Anchored by a sound that bridges the anthemic power of Foo Fighters with the irreverent edge of Sum 41, FELICITY have built traction both online and on stage. Their viral content consistently reaches millions and they have shared the stage supporting legends like Fall Out Boy, The Used, and Story of the Year, along with festival appearances at Warped Cruise, So What?! Music Fest, and more.With their new album Mixtape, Vol. 2 (Out June 16th 2026) produced by Andrew Wade (A Day To Remember, Neck Deep), FELICITY is doubling down on their biggest strength: creating songs that hit like a mosh pit but stick like an arena chorus. They are a band in motion, actively building one of the most engaged fanbases in the alternative rock resurgence and positioning themselves as one of the next breakout live acts from North America.
